title: Dataset, code and trained models for: Predicting Marsh Funnel Flow Time and Mini-Slump of Fly Ash–Cement Pastes from PCE Superplasticizer Descriptors: Equilibrium Optimizer-Tuned Models under Nested and Leave-One-Admixture-Out Validation with SHAP Interpretation
description: Experimental dataset (616 cement–fly ash–PCE pastes), leakage-free nested validation pipeline (revision/), trained models, the Flask GUI and the Gradio app of the online GUI (https://huggingface.co/spaces/ibrahimayaz/pce-predictor). Dataset: https://dx.doi.org/10.21227/fjdp-ss56
